title: Nails on a Spring
body: In building a house, carpenters use nails from a large box suspended from a spring. The spring stretch is proportional to the weight it supports. At the beginning of the day, the spring stretches $$50\, \text{cm}$$. $$At$$ $$the$$ $$end$$ $$of$$ $$the$$ $$day$$, $$the$$ $$spring$$ $$stretches$$ $$30\, \text{cm}$$.
